stock.description: Polyfair Holdings Limited functions as an investment vehicle primarily involved in Hong Kong's construction industry. The company is particularly skilled in designing and delivering innovative façade systems and curtain wall solutions for both residential and commercial properties. Its extensive design and build services encompass a wide range of activities, including conceptualizing designs, performing structural analyses, preparing detailed shop drawings, sourcing and acquiring construction materials, managing material logistics and installation, overseeing projects, and providing support after project completion. Polyfair collaborates with various material suppliers and subcontractors. Founded in 2006, the firm maintains its headquarters in North Point, Hong Kong, and operates as a subsidiary of C.N.Y. Holdings Limited.
